title: Turkish-Style Stir-Fried Lotus Kofte
description: A Chinese-inspired dish using Turkish-style kofte and lotus root, mixed with wholesome spices and crunchy vegetables. This recipe combines the flavors of the Mediterranean with the snap of Chinese cuisine.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced lotus root and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until it starts to soften.
Add the sliced carrots and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Add the Turkish-style kofte and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned and cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and paprika.
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the kofte and vegetables, and stir to coat.
Continue to cook for another minute, or until the flavors have melded together.
Serve hot, garnished with additional paprika if desired.
